run.name: APi Group Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (APG)
run.summary: APi Group is a diversified, cash-generative services business whose leverage rose in 2026 as acquisitions and buybacks were debt-funded: total debt over adjusted EBITDA is 3.02x on a last-twelve-months basis against 2.67x at FY2025. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Reported EBITDA (net income + interest + tax + D&A), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt obligations 3,601 and cash 373 at Sep 30, 2026 over derived LTM adjusted EBITDA 1,191 (FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025); acquired EBITDA only from closing dates, no pro forma; the 100 revolver draw after quarter-end is excluded

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Derived LTM adjusted EBITDA 1,191 over derived LTM cash interest 129; flatters run-rate because the May 2026 notes pay semi-annually and the quarter's cash interest is 38; on Q3 2026 interest expense, net, annualised (45 times 4) cover would be 6.62x, an indicative figure only

cash.basis: Cash. Revolver availability after 335 drawn and 6 of letters of credit on a 1,000 facility; issuer reports total liquidity of 1,032; facility matures May 14, 2031

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Executed financing documents are not supplied, so covenant definitions, guarantors and permitted payments cannot be verified.
CP-1 main limitation: Last-twelve-months figures are derived, adjusted EBITDA is management-defined, and covenant EBITDA is not supplied.
